claims.statement: The starter plugin separates host-testable pure logic from wasm-only plugin glue, is no_std only on wasm32, depends on the SDK only for wasm32 with the panic_handler feature, and builds release with opt-level z, LTO, one codegen unit, abort on panic and stripping.
The starter plugin's SDK dependency path points into the development repo's vendor submodule, which is not vendored in this repository.
gpio_mqtt declares wifi, socket, grove, sao, ui_exclusive and prevent_sleep, the GPIO pins 4-7, 9, 14, 38, 40, 43 and 44, an rmem secret mqtt_pass and a wifi_connected prerequisite.
The matrix plugin declares 1024 KB linear memory, four rmem names and wifi/http/ui_exclusive/prevent_sleep capabilities.
thermo_printer provides the thermo_print external feature and declares ble, vcard, vfat, wifi, net_listen, background and autoload with image/jpeg message type.
sdk_probe is a serial diagnostic that exercises every SDK binding and declares nearly all capabilities including ecc, rmem, display_lowlevel, i2c bus 1 and a provided feature.
webserver serves files from its vFAT folder over HTTP on port 80 using the net_listen capability as an autoload background plugin.
grove_led is an autoload background plugin driving a WS2813 strip through the pixel_strip capability.
canvas_demo steps through canvas primitives, bitmaps, CP437 symbols, shades, elements, tweens, sprites and z-order layers without any capability.

plugins/snake is the first member of the root Cargo workspace: a verbatim copy of the upstream production snake (references/cdc-badge-plugins/plugins/snake) with only the SDK dependency repointed to the vendored path ../../references/cdc-badge-plugins/sdk/cdc-badge-plugin (feature panic_handler), and crate-type cdylib+rlib so the pure game logic is host-testable.

The in-repo snake declares host_api_level_min 0.8, 64 KB linear memory, ui_exclusive and nvs_namespace plg_snake; it has 18 host unit tests (cargo test -p snake), builds to a ~30 KB wasm that passed the in-repo contract checks, and was flashed and run on a real badge.
